say:3:1421916001:1.text: W—What does this mean? Is it telling me where my treasure is?
say:3:1421916001:1.source_cn: 这、这是啥意思？是不是讲了俺的宝物在哪？

say:4:1421916002:1.text: This describes the disaster that led to the Ironheart Dominion's downfall! "The dragon's fire reduced the empire to ashes..." How tragic...
say:4:1421916002:1.source_cn: 这描写的是那场使钢心帝国覆灭的灾难！龙息将帝国毁为焦土...

say:5:1421916003:1.text: In a way, the dwarves brought this upon themselves…
say:5:1421916003:1.source_cn: 造成这种后果，某种程度上也是矮人咎由自取……

say:6:1421916004:1.text: I know this part of the history—the Ironheart Dominion fell because our ancestors angered the dragon. But what does this have to do with the treasure?
say:6:1421916004:1.source_cn: 这些事俺也知道一点，钢心帝国不在了，因为俺们的先祖惹怒...

say:7:1421916005:1.text: The fleeing dwarves... Upper level... The mine...

say:8:1421916006:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
say:8:1421916006:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
say:8:1421916006:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.

choice_prompt:9:1421916006.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你应该知道吧，那场覆灭钢心帝国的灾难……伴随着一场惨烈的逃亡。
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.
choice_prompt:9:1421916006.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you know what happened after the disaster? A harrowing escape.

say:10:1421916007:1.source_cn: ……那些幸存的矮人就是我们的先祖。

say:11:1421916008:1.text: This trail keeps leading us upward... There's a good chance we're following the exact route our ancestors took when they fled.
say:11:1421916008:1.source_cn: 魔力指引着我们一路往上……我怀疑，我们循着的这条道路，...

say:12:1421916009:1.text: So, this journal was probably something left behind by Drew's ancestor during their escape... This makes me feel a bit sad...
say:12:1421916009:1.source_cn: 所以这手札极有可能是当年德鲁的先祖在逃亡过程中遗留下来...

say:13:1421916010:1.text: This belonged to my ancestor? Thank you so much! Without you all, I wouldn't have even understood the writings... I'll keep it safe...
say:13:1421916010:1.source_cn: 这是俺先祖的遗物……谢谢你们，没有你们，俺都不知道先祖...

say:14:1421916011:1.text: But the journal still doesn't explain why the magic trail led us here...
say:14:1421916011:1.source_cn: 但手札还是没有解释为什么找那件珍重之物会找到这里……

say:15:1421916012:1.text: I saw words like "upper level" and "mine." in the journal. Our ancestors must have headed upward during their escape. We might find something in the mine above!
say:15:1421916012:1.source_cn: 这里面还提到了上层、矿洞这些词，如果先祖们要逃亡，一定...

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 大部分矮人失去了生命
